usageNotes: Use this to provision a new Ceph storage pool on the cluster via the specified node (any healthy monitor node works). The operation is asynchronous — the return value is a task UPID; poll the task until complete before referencing the pool in storage config. Requires `Sys.Modify` at the root (`/`) and Ceph must already be initialized on the cluster; set `add_storages: true` to automatically wire the pool as a Proxmox storage entry (mandatory for EC pools to be useful).

examples.summary: Create a standard 3-replica RBD pool for VM disks with PG autoscaling enabled

tips: The `name` param must be cluster-unique and cannot contain colons, slashes, or whitespace.
For erasure-coded pools, `size`/`min_size`/`crush_rule` apply to the companion metadata (replicated) pool, not the EC pool itself.
Leave `pg_num` unset and set `pg_autoscale_mode` to `on` for new clusters — Ceph will size PGs correctly as data grows.
Providing `target_size` or `target_size_ratio` gives the PG autoscaler a better hint and avoids the default `warn` state on small pools.
The returned UPID can be tracked via `get_nodes_node_tasks_upid_status` to confirm the pool creation completed before adding VMs.
